description: Shows the agent's to-do list as a checklist inside the conversation.

desktop.description: Shows the thread's to-do list as one card above the working line in place of to-do tool rows.

interface.shortDescription: Follow the agent's to-dos in the chat
interface.longDescription: One checklist card follows the agent's work at the end of the conversation and marks the step in progress. It stays after a stopped turn while steps remain and clears once every step is done.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan this work as a to-do list and keep it updated as you go.
